summary: One church with an on-site chapel for daily Mass and weekday Adoration; both image-only bulletins (Nov 8, Nov 15) print the same schedule, which the website matches. No 12:10 PM Mass on Wednesdays. Open: whether the Sunday 'Adoration & Masses in the Church 9 am-1 pm' line is an Adoration time (leaning no), and the passing Christmas Eve 10 PM Midnight Mass (leaning include).
